convention_detail: z = q³/(q² + 1) = q²/[2]_q. Under D, X = Q² exactly (integer-level Wenzl SU_q(2) specialisation). All expressions are in ℚ(q) — no √q terms.
description: Symbolic closed-form y_λ for n = 2..12 via the Wenzl bridge: y_λ = s_{λ, X}(Q) / Σ_µ d_µ s_{µ, X}(Q) with Q = q² and X = Q² (convention D).
